input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: My first post had a 224-character description. The build rejects anything over 160, and 3 build tests failed until I shortened it.
An inline sizing script placed right after the ticker blocked the parser on pending stylesheets, so CLS went to 0.89. I replaced it with a CSS reservation plus the end-of-body script.

doc_friction.issue: With TMPDIR set to the scratchpad path, chrome-launcher's checkReady times out and every page errors. The header now warns about this.

The output table had no TBT or FCP column and used one run. Under devtools throttling TBT is 600-1000 ms on wall-framing-takeoff, but the simulated table showed only FCP, so three polish reports in a row carried FCP-aimed fixes forward. Both columns and --runs=N are added now.
Its next-step hypotheses (modulepreload placement, content-visibility) were both null when A/B tested. Recorded in this run's report so later runs stop carrying them.

deviations.why: I picked the performance item the last reports carried, not the 'weakest visible surface'. The measurement then turned up a visible defect on the hub, and I fixed that.
deviations.did: Measured three perf hypotheses (all null), shipped the hub ticker layout-shift fix and the measuring tools.
deviations.result: Hub CLS 0.087 to 0.005 under devtools Lighthouse. Hero height constant over a full word cycle.

deviations.why: I fixed another run's breakage (#14774's duplicated FAQ) inside a polish PR instead of a separate one, because it was turning every PR's CI red.

notes: Verification: node platform/pages/build.mjs exited 0. check.mjs: publishable, no dead links. node --test platform/pages/*.test.mjs: 1533/1536 pass; the 3 failures were the post description length, now fixed, and build.test.mjs was rerun. ticker-fit.test.mjs fails 3 of 5 with the fix removed. CI after merging main: validate and test both failed on ventures/concrete-maturity/index.html, where #14774 had pasted the FAQ section in twice (a duplicate id 'faq' and duplicated FAQ items), which broke main. I fixed it forward in this PR by removing the copy inside <main>. check_duplicate_ids passes and the concrete-maturity tests pass 32/32.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: perf A/B across 4 variants, profiling, a layout-shift fix with a browser test, two tools, a report and a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
